lines.notes: Orange Line (Line 2) runs north-south from Karond Circle to AIIMS Bhopal (14.99 km, 16 stations). The 6.22 km priority stretch from Subhash Nagar to AIIMS with 8 stations is operational. Northward extension to Karond Circle is under active construction.
